notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome110), no block encountered; Playwright used once just to render the homepage mega-menu DOM (client-rendered nav) since the raw HTML's embedded window.APP_DATA blob did not expose navigation data. robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows /dashboard/, /order/, /wishlist/, /products/?*, /collections?* etc - no Claude/anthropic-bot-specific block found, and no CAPTCHA/403 hit at any point. NOTE: an early exploratory fetch of /products/?l1_category=... (2 requests) technically matched the disallowed '/products/?*' pattern before this was noticed; that path's data was discovered to be unreliable anyway (canonical resolved to generic /products 'SearchResultsPage', not the requested category) and was discarded - no output row depends on it, and no further /products/?* requests were made. TREE: This India storefront runs on Fynd Commerce (per westelm.in/agents.md), not the Shopify platform used by westelm.com (SR2) / westelm.co.uk (SR57) - built the tree independently for this locale. sitemap.xml's category_l1/l2/l3 sub-sitemaps only contain generic placeholder/example entries (test-l1, decor, furniture, storage / test-l2, home-accent, living-furniture, organiser / test-l3, vases, sofas, hampers-baskets) and are not an exhaustive taxonomy, so the tree was built from the rendered mega-menu (Playwright, all /collection/{slug} links, deduped from 382 raw hrefs to 152 unique) cross-checked against the same menu re-rendered on an inner page - identical on both, confirming full coverage; no separate footer links added categories. QTY: each /collection/{slug} page is a genuine 'CollectionPage' (verified via embedded ld+json @type and canonical==requested URL on every leaf recorded) with an embedded Fynd product-list pagination object of the form page:{has_previous,has_next,item_total,type:'cursor'} - this cursor-typed item_total (verified by page 1 raw item count matching Entryway Furniture: 12 SSR'd cards + has_next:true + item_total:19) is the true full-category count and was used as qty for every row. A second, unrelated fixed 'item_total':2 / type:'number' field also appears on every page (some other static widget, not the product grid) - deliberately NOT used since it returned an identical '2' on every page tested regardless of actual inventory, which is how the confusion was caught and corrected. EXCLUDED: Wall Art (art-and-mirrors-wall-art, 11 items) - mixed category containing some fabric/woven pieces (Pixelated Embroidery, Tonal Thread, Two-Tone Fabric, Thick Woven) alongside non-textile pieces (Capiz, Gilded Pendant, paper); no separate pure-textile-wall-hangings subcategory exists so the blended node was left to the Wall Decor task per no-estimation/no-splitting rule. Pouffs (pillows-and-decor-pillows-and-throws-pouffs) - category exists in nav but currently lists 0 products, so material/type could not be confirmed (poufs are frequently solid ottoman-furniture rather than textile) - excluded rather than guessed. Bath Accessories (bedding-and-bath-bath-linen-and-accessories-bath-accessories, 6 items: marble/resin trays, waste bin) - non-textile decorative bathroom objects, not storage either. Baskets + Hampers (pillows-and-decor-room-decor-baskets-and-hampers) - page title says 'Storage Baskets & Laundry Hampers' but qty=1 and that single listed product is a 'Woven Metal Bowl' (decorative bowl per storage.md rule 23), not a genuine storage basket - excluded from Storage as unsupported by the actual product. Storage Furniture tree (furniture-storage-furniture-all-storage-furniture qty=7, furniture-storage-furniture-entryway-furniture qty=19) - explicitly nested under the site's top-level FURNITURE department; sampled products are bookshelves, media consoles, shoe racks, coat racks, a room divider and bar carts/buffets/bar cabinets under 'Dining Storage' - all genuine furniture pieces per Furniture-boundary rules, not storage containers/organizers, so excluded from both arrays despite the word 'Storage' in the category names. Dinnerware/Serveware/Flatware/Bar & Glassware, Room Decor (Vases/Candles/Lanterns/Sculptures/Jewellery Boxes), Planters & Botanicals, Lighting, Furniture (all subtrees), Art & Mirrors (Mirrors, Picture Frames), Gifts and Sale collection pages - excluded as Kitchen & Dining / Decorative Accessories / Lighting / Furniture / Wall Decor / promotional-collection domain per rule 27. Net result: no genuine standalone Storage category exists on this storefront at present (storage_rows is correctly empty, not a missed search).
